name: ledgerly-motion
description: Remotion motion-graphics demo for Ledgerly. Development-only tooling: never a dependency of the app.

scripts.render: npm run sync && remotion render Master out/ledgerly-master.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=17 --pixel-format=yuv420p
scripts.render:silent: npm run sync && remotion render MasterSilent out/ledgerly-master-silent.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=17 --pixel-format=yuv420p
scripts.render:vertical: npm run sync && remotion render Vertical out/ledgerly-vertical.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=17 --pixel-format=yuv420p
scripts.render:square: npm run sync && remotion render Square out/ledgerly-square.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=17 --pixel-format=yuv420p
scripts.render:cutdown: npm run sync && remotion render Cutdown out/ledgerly-17s.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=17 --pixel-format=yuv420p
